description: This file provides functions for processing, validating, and converting domain names between ASCII and Unicode formats, including handling IDN (Internationalized Domain Names) encoding rules and validation per RFC standards.

methods.name: containsNonASCII(str)
methods.description: Checks if the given string contains any non-ASCII characters.

methods.name: findStatus(val)
methods.description: Performs a binary search in the mappingTable to find the status and mapping for a given code point.

methods.name: mapChars(domainName, { transitionalProcessing })
methods.description: Maps each character in a domain name according to its status in the IDNA mapping table, considering transitional processing.

methods.name: validateLabel(label, { checkHyphens, checkBidi, checkJoiners, transitionalProcessing, useSTD3ASCIIRules, isBidi })
methods.description: Validates a domain label against multiple rules including normalization, hyphen placement, joiners, bidi, and code point statuses.

methods.name: isBidiDomain(labels)
methods.description: Determines if a domain is a Bidirectional domain based on its labels and their Unicode properties.

methods.name: processing(domainName, options)
methods.description: Processes a domain name: maps characters, normalizes, splits into labels, checks bidi, and validates each label.

methods.name: toASCII(domainName, { checkHyphens = false, checkBidi = false, checkJoiners = false, useSTD3ASCIIRules = false, verifyDNSLength = false, transitionalProcessing = false, ignoreInvalidPunycode = false } = {})
methods.description: Converts a domain name to its ASCII-compatible encoding (Punycode) with various validation and processing options.

methods.name: toUnicode(domainName, { checkHyphens = false, checkBidi = false, checkJoiners = false, useSTD3ASCIIRules = false, transitionalProcessing = false, ignoreInvalidPunycode = false } = {})
methods.description: Converts an ASCII domain name (possibly Punycode) into its Unicode form with validation.

ctags.name: toASCII
ctags.signature: (domainName, { checkHyphens = false, checkBidi = false, checkJoiners = false, useSTD3ASCIIRules = false, verifyDNSLength = false, transitionalProcessing = false, ignoreInvalidPunycode = false } = {})

ctags.name: toUnicode
ctags.signature: (domainName, { checkHyphens = false, checkBidi = false, checkJoiners = false, useSTD3ASCIIRules = false, transitionalProcessing = false, ignoreInvalidPunycode = false } = {})

ctags.name: validateLabel
ctags.signature: (label, { checkHyphens, checkBidi, checkJoiners, transitionalProcessing, useSTD3ASCIIRules, isBidi })
